inserts.rationale: New portal to enable external customer access
New integration layer for secure data access

exploration.gap_analysis: No external access layer exists for exposing internal systems to B2B customers. Multi-tenant data isolation and authentication are missing.
exploration.sunset_risks: No immediate sunset risks identified as all existing systems remain in use.
exploration.maturity_trends: Introduction of new portal and backend API improves maturity of customer engagement and data security capabilities.
exploration.overlaps: No significant overlaps detected. Existing systems are reused effectively.

recommendations: Prioritize development of the External Customer Portal and Backend API to enable secure external access.
Ensure Entra External ID is configured for B2B customer authentication.
Conduct multi-tenant isolation testing to validate data security.
Leverage existing MedPack API and QAD Analytics Database to minimize new development.
